title: FLA import: static text field orientation (horizontal/vertical/vertical-LR) not decoded from binary
description: Fixed in commit 823cbec. Decoded CPicText per-run vertical/rtl bytes into Fla8TextOrientation (horizontal|vertical-rtl|vertical-ltr) in flash8-binary.ts and forwarded through convertFla8Text in flash8-import.ts. Added orientation to engine/types.ts TextDisplayObject. DefineEditText has no orientation flag — documented in swf/src/text.ts comment. All tests pass.
